title: Bound
description: A simple little mod that sets the area in which a player can be, and kill them if they get out.
body:
A simple little mod that sets the area in which a player can be, and kill them if they get out. Great for prisons, or if you don't want to get distracted.

## How does this mod work?

Get a potion and drink it. You will now, whilst the potion is active, be limited to an area around where you drank the potion. There are five kinds of potion I made:

```
| Name..................... | Duration.... | Max. Distance |
|---------------------------|--------------|---------------|
| Potion of Binding 1...... | 1:30 min.... | 32 blocks.... |
| Potion of Binding 2...... | 3:00 min.... | 40 blocks.... |
| Potion of Binding 3...... | 6:00 min.... | 48 blocks.... |
| Potion of Binding 4...... | 12 min...... | 64 blocks.... |
| Potion of Binding Forever | - infinite - | 80 blocks.... |
|---------------------------|--------------|---------------|
```
